recipes.name: Fluffy Pancakes
recipes.description: Classic fluffy pancakes perfect for weekend breakfast

photos.alt: Stack of fluffy golden pancakes topped with butter and syrup
photos.caption: Golden, fluffy pancakes ready to serve

photos.alt: Close-up of pancake texture showing fluffiness
photos.caption: Perfect texture and golden color

instructions.instruction: Add melted butter to the milk and mix well.
Beat eggs until fluffy and combine with the milk mixture.

photos.alt: Fluffy beaten eggs in a mixing bowl
photos.caption: Beat eggs until light and fluffy

instructions.instruction: In a separate bowl, combine all dry ingredients (flour, salt, sugar, bicarbonate soda, baking powder).
Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients. Don't over mix.
Let the batter sit for 30 minutes before cooking.
Pour gently onto a heated pan, allowing the batter to be thick. Don't spread it out.

photos.alt: Pancake batter being poured onto griddle
photos.caption: Pour batter gently, don't spread

instructions.instruction: Cook slowly over medium-low heat until bubbles form on the surface.
Flip and cook until golden brown on both sides.

photos.alt: Pancake being flipped on griddle showing golden brown color
photos.caption: Flip when bubbles form and edges are set

recipes.name: Classic Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Traditional Italian pizza with fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil

photos.alt: Classic Margherita pizza with melted mozzarella and fresh basil
photos.caption: Traditional Margherita pizza

instructions.instruction: Mix warm water, yeast, and sugar. Let stand 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour, olive oil, and salt. Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place in oiled bowl, cover, and let rise for 1.5 hours until doubled.
Divide dough into 2 portions. Roll each into a 12-inch circle.
Spread crushed tomatoes over dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Tear mozzarella and distribute evenly over sauce.
Bake at 475°F (245°C) for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden.
Remove from oven and top with fresh basil leaves. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Creamy Indian curry with tender chicken in spiced tomato sauce

instructions.instruction: Marinate chicken in yogurt, 1 tablespoon garam masala, cumin, paprika, and salt for 30 minutes.
Heat butter in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add marinated chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 8-10 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté onion until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato sauce and remaining garam masala. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add heavy cream and return chicken to pan.
Simmer for 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce is thickened.
Serve hot with rice or naan bread.

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Classic Caesar salad with homemade dressing and crispy croutons

instructions.instruction: Wash and chop romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Pat dry thoroughly.
In a food processor, blend garlic, anchovies, lemon juice, and Dijon mustard.
With processor running, slowly drizzle in olive oil until emulsified.
Add half the Parmesan cheese to the dressing and pulse to combine.
In a large bowl, toss lettuce with dressing until evenly coated.
Add croutons and remaining Parmesan.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately while croutons are still crispy.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy chocolate chip cookies with crispy edges

instructions.instruction: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
In a large bowl, cream together butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
Gradually blend in the flour mixture.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until golden brown around edges.
Cool on baking sheet for 2 minutes before transferring to wire rack.

recipes.name: Classic Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Flavorful ground beef tacos with fresh toppings

instructions.instruction: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
Drain excess fat from the pan.
Add taco seasoning and water to the beef, stirring well.
Simmer for 5 minutes until sauce thickens.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
Fill each shell with seasoned beef.
Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, sour cream, and salsa.
Serve immediately while shells are warm and crispy.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
recipes.description: Quick and healthy Asian-inspired vegetable stir fry

instructions.instruction: Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, cornstarch, and water in a small bowl. Set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stir fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add carrots and broccoli, stir fry for 3 minutes.
Add bell peppers and snap peas, stir fry for 2 minutes.
Pour sauce over vegetables and toss to coat.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens and vegetables are crisp-tender.
Serve immediately over rice or noodles.

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
recipes.description: Rich caramelized onion soup with melted Gruyère cheese

instructions.instruction: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onions and cook, stirring frequently, for 40-45 minutes until deeply caramelized.
Add wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add beef broth, bay leaves, thyme, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Toast baguette slices until golden.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls.
Top each bowl with 2 baguette slices and shredded Gruyère.
Broil for 2-3 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden.
Serve immediately, being careful as bowls will be hot.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Fresh Mediterranean salad with feta cheese and olives

instructions.instruction: In a large bowl, combine cucumbers, tomatoes, red onion, and olives.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over vegetables and toss gently to combine.
Top with crumbled feta cheese.
Let salad sit for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Toss gently once more before serving.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.

recipes.name: Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist and flavorful banana bread perfect for breakfast or snacks

instructions.instruction: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
In a mixing bowl, mash the ripe bananas with a fork until smooth.
Stir the melted butter into the mashed bananas.
Mix in baking soda and salt.
Stir in brown sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla extract.
Mix in flour until just incorporated. Don't overmix.
Fold in walnuts if using.
Pour batter into prepared loaf pan.
Bake for 60-65 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.name: Soft Banana Yoghurt Muffins
recipes.description: Soft, cloud-like banana muffins made with Greek yoghurt and almond meal. Riper bananas make them softer, and the yoghurt keeps them moist and tender.

photos.alt: Batch of soft golden banana yoghurt muffins in a muffin tray
photos.caption: Soft banana yoghurt muffins fresh from the oven

ingredients.item: sweetener, to taste — Stevia or a little sugar, depending on how sweet the bananas are (optional)
cottage cheese, blended smooth or mashed in, for extra softness and protein (optional)

instructions.instruction: Heat oven to 180°C.
Mash bananas until almost no lumps remain — riper bananas give softer muffins.
Mix the mashed banana, eggs, and Greek yoghurt together.
Stir in the dry ingredients until only just combined — do not overmix, or the muffins will lose their cloud-like texture.
Spoon the batter into a muffin tray.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and cooked through.

recipes.name: Savoury Meatloaf Patties
recipes.description: Vegetable-packed beef patties made with 500 g of mince, great hot for dinner or cold in work lunches — in a sandwich with cheese and mustard, crumbled over a salad, or with roasted vegetables. For extra fibre and to stretch the mince, increase the vegetables to 1 onion, 2 carrots and 1 zucchini.

photos.alt: Golden-brown savoury meatloaf patties in a frying pan
photos.caption: Savoury meatloaf patties fresh from the pan

ingredients.item: small zucchini, grated and squeezed dry (optional but recommended)

instructions.instruction: Sauté the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in a little oil until softened, about 8 minutes. Let cool.
Mix everything together gently.
Let the mixture rest for 10-15 minutes so the oats absorb some moisture.
Form into 6 large or 8 medium patties.
Cook over medium heat with a little oil for about 5-6 minutes per side, then reduce the heat, cover with a lid, and cook another 2-3 minutes if needed until cooked through.

Optional: use the same frying pan to make a quick onion gravy — add a little butter and a teaspoon of flour, then whisk in beef or chicken stock. Spoon over the patties for dinner and keep leftovers plain for lunches.

recipes.name: Veggie-Packed Meatloaf
recipes.description: A meal-prep meatloaf with around 40-50% vegetables by volume — cheaper, lighter, and it stays moist for reheating. Spread thin in a large baking dish for even cooking and more browned edges. Serve with mashed potato and beans, cold in a sandwich, crumbled into pasta, with roasted pumpkin and broccoli, or over rice with gravy.

photos.alt: Sliced vegetable-packed meatloaf in a large baking dish with browned edges
photos.caption: Veggie-packed meatloaf with browned edges

ingredients.item: small zucchini, grated and squeezed dry
mushrooms, finely chopped (optional, 200-250 g — cooked down with the onion they boost savoury flavour, stretch the mince and keep the loaf moist)

instructions.instruction: Heat oven to 180°C.
Sauté the onion, carrot, celery, capsicum and garlic (and mushrooms, if using — cook until most of their moisture evaporates) in a little oil until softened. Let cool.
Mix everything together gently and let rest for 10-15 minutes so the oats absorb some moisture.
Spread the mixture into a 23 × 33 cm (9 × 13 inch) baking dish.
Bake for 45-55 minutes until cooked through. (For a thicker traditional loaf, use a 23 × 13 cm loaf tin and bake 60-70 minutes.)
Rest before slicing into about 8 servings.

recipes.name: Savoury Cheese and Corn Oat Muffins
recipes.description: Hearty savoury muffins made with soaked oats, which keep them soft, moist and fresh for longer — great for work lunches. Soaking in sour cream gives the richest result, yoghurt a slightly lighter texture, and milk works if that's all you have. Add cooked bacon, diced ham, feta, spinach or chopped roasted pumpkin if you like.

photos.alt: Golden savoury muffins with cheese and corn on a cooling rack
photos.caption: Savoury cheese and corn oat muffins

ingredients.item: sour cream, plain yoghurt or milk, for soaking the oats
baking soda (if using sour cream or yoghurt)

instructions.instruction: Soak the oats in the sour cream, yoghurt or milk for at least 30 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, then stir in the soaked oats, cheese, onion, carrot and corn.
Add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, paprika, garlic powder and pepper, and stir until only just combined — keep at least 1 cup of plain flour so the muffins have enough structure to rise well.
Fill muffin cups about ¾ full.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.name: Fluffy Chocolate Yoghurt Muffins
recipes.description: Light, fluffy chocolate muffins made with two eggs and no oil — the berry yoghurt keeps them soft and adds a subtle fruity note. Mix gently and bake straight away for the best rise. A mashed ripe banana makes them even moister.

photos.alt: Fluffy chocolate muffins made with berry yoghurt on a plate
photos.caption: Fluffy chocolate yoghurt muffins

ingredients.item: monkfruit sweetener (½-¾ cup depending on the brand)
milk (½-¾ cup, enough for a thick but spoonable batter)

instructions.instruction: Heat oven to 180°C (or 200°C for the first 5 minutes, then down to 180°C for a taller muffin top).
Mix all the dry ingredients.
Whisk together the eggs, yoghurt and milk.

Fold wet into dry until just combined. The batter should be thick but spoonable — add a splash more milk if it seems too stiff. Don't let the batter sit; get it straight into the oven for the best rise.
Fill muffin cups about ¾ full.
Bake for 18-22 minutes.

recipes.name: Fluffy Chocolate Muffins
recipes.description: Soft, fluffy chocolate muffins made with berry yoghurt and coconut oil — the berry gives a subtle black forest vibe. For a double-chocolate version, stir in ½ cup dark chocolate chips, or fold in ½ cup frozen berries for chocolate-berry muffins. If your monkfruit sweetener is a 1:1 blend, ½ cup gives a moderately sweet muffin and ¾ cup is more dessert-like.

photos.alt: Fluffy chocolate muffins in a lined muffin tin
photos.caption: Fluffy chocolate muffins with a hint of berry

ingredients.item: monkfruit sweetener (½-¾ cup depending on the brand's sweetness)
milk (or enough to make a thick but scoopable batter)
instant coffee powder (optional — deepens the chocolate flavour without tasting like coffee)

instructions.instruction: Preheat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). For a taller muffin top, bake at 200°C for the first 5 minutes, then reduce to 180°C.
Mix the flour, almond meal, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, salt and monkfruit sweetener.
In another bowl, whisk together the egg, yoghurt, coconut oil, milk and vanilla.
Fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just combined — don't overmix, and bake as soon as it's mixed.
Divide into a lined muffin tin, filling each about ¾ full.
Bake for 18-22 minutes.

recipes.name: Fluffy Banana Muffins
recipes.description: Very soft, fluffy banana muffins using baking powder for lift and baking soda reacting with the yoghurt's acidity for extra rise and tenderness. Mix gently, don't let the batter sit, and get them into the oven quickly for maximum fluffiness.

photos.alt: Golden fluffy banana muffins cooling on a wire rack
photos.caption: Fluffy banana muffins with honey yoghurt

ingredients.item: large bananas, thawed and mashed (about 1 cup)

instructions.instruction: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). If your oven runs cool, start at 200°C for 5 minutes, then reduce to 180°C for the remaining bake.
Grease or line a 12-hole muffin tin.
In one bowl, mash the bananas (thaw completely and drain off any excess liquid) and whisk in the yoghurt, egg and oil.
In another bowl, combine the flour, almond meal, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add dry ingredients to wet and stir only until combined — a few lumps are fine, and not overmixing is the biggest factor for fluffiness.
Fill muffin cups about ¾ full.
Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes before removing from the tin.
